description: Measure the page’s theme: the relative luminance of its background and text, whether it is rendering light or dark, the palette actually painted on screen grouped into surface, text, border and accent colours with how much area each covers, the CSS custom properties (design tokens) resolved at :root, the type scale, a nested tree of the page’s coloured surfaces with a text diagram, and any dark/light theme hook its own stylesheets define (a ".dark" class or a [data-theme] attribute). Read this before page.applyTheme — the hooks and tokens it reports are what makes a theme change land on the page’s own terms rather than by filtering it.

maxPerGroup.description: Colours listed per palette group, widest coverage first

maxScan.description: Elements to measure; a larger document is sampled at an even stride across it

maxSurfaces.description: Coloured surfaces kept in the surface tree, largest region first

maxTokens.description: CSS custom properties listed, sorted by name; 0 skips them

name: page_readTheme
